entries.title: Exodus 25:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 25:2
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring Me an offering. You shall take an offering from every man that gives it willingly with his heart.

entries.title: Exodus 25:3
segments: And this [is] the offering which you shall take of them: gold, and silver, and brass,

entries.title: Exodus 25:4
segments: and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and bleached [linen], and goats' [hair],

entries.title: Exodus 25:5
segments: and rams' skins dyed red, and dugong skins, and acacia-wood,

entries.title: Exodus 25:6
segments: oil for the light, spices for anointing oil and for sweet incense,

entries.title: Exodus 25:7
segments: onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod and in the breast-pocket.

entries.title: Exodus 25:8
segments: And let them make Me a sanctuary, so that I may dwell among them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:9
segments: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments of it, even so you shall make [it].

entries.title: Exodus 25:10
segments: And they shall make an ark [of] acacia-wood. Two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high.

entries.title: Exodus 25:11
segments: And you shall overlay it [with] pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and out, and shall make on it a crown of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:12
segments: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and shall put [it] on its four feet. And two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:13
segments: And you shall make staves [of] acacia-wood, and overlay them [with] gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:14
segments: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, so that the ark may be carried with them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:15
segments: And the staves shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:16
segments: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:17
segments: And you shall make a mercy-seat [of] pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be the length of it, and a cubit and a half the breadth of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:18
segments: And you shall make two cherubs [of] gold; of beaten work you shall make them, in the two ends of the mercy-seat.

entries.title: Exodus 25:19
segments: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end. From the mercy-seat you shall make the cherubs, on the two ends of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:20
segments: And the cherubs shall stretch forth [their] wings on high, covering the mercy-seat with their wings, and their faces each toward the other; toward the mercy-seat shall the cherubs' faces be.

entries.title: Exodus 25:21
segments: And you shall put the mercy-seat above, upon the ark. And in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.

entries.title: Exodus 25:22
segments: And I will meet with you there, and I will talk with you from above the mercy-seat, from between the two cherubs on the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment to the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 25:23
segments: You shall also make a table [of] acacia-wood, its length two cubits, and its breadth a cubit, and its height a cubit and a half.

entries.title: Exodus 25:24
segments: And you shall overlay it [with] pure gold, and make to this a crown of gold all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:25
segments: And you shall make to it a border of a hand's breadth round about. And you shall make a golden crown to the border of it, all around.

entries.title: Exodus 25:26
segments: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that [are] on the four feet of it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:27
segments: The rings shall be adjoining the border as housings for the staves to carry the table.

entries.title: Exodus 25:28
segments: And you shall make the staves [of] acacia-wood and overlay them with gold, so that the table may be carried with them.

entries.title: Exodus 25:29
segments: And you shall make its dishes, and its spoons, and its pitchers, and its sacrificial cups [with] which a drink-offering is made. You shall make them [of] pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:30
segments: And you shall set upon the table showbread before Me always.

entries.title: Exodus 25:31
segments: And you shall make a lampstand [of] pure gold. The lampstand shall be made of beaten work; its shaft, and its branches, its cups, its knobs, and its blossoms, shall be from it.

entries.title: Exodus 25:32
segments: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it-- three branches of the lampstand out of the one side, and three branches of the lampstand out of the other side.

entries.title: Exodus 25:33
segments: Three almond-like cups on the one branch, [with] knob and blossom; and three almond-like cups on the one branch, [with] knob and blossom, so for the six branches, those going out of the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 25:34
segments: And in the lampstand [shall be] four almond-like cups, [with] their knobs and their blossoms;

entries.title: Exodus 25:35
segments: and a knob under two branches of it, and a knob under two branches of it, and a knob under two branches of it, according to the six branches, those going out of the lampstand.

entries.title: Exodus 25:36
segments: Their knobs and their branches [shall be] of it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:37
segments: And you shall make the seven lamps of it. And one shall light the lamps of it, so that they may give light on its face.

entries.title: Exodus 25:38
segments: And the tongs of it, and its pans [shall be] of pure gold.

entries.title: Exodus 25:39
segments: One shall make it [of] a talent of pure gold, with all these vessels.

entries.title: Exodus 25:40
segments: And see that you make them after their pattern, which was shown you in the mountain.
